propositions: Four overlay and leaf-routed agent criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) generated ~7,900 wasted agentic executions across 1,939 runs with zero findings each

Deterministic pre-filter gates must fire only when subject vocabulary is entirely present, skipping LLM routing only on total vocabulary absence, leaving the LLM router as the applicability authority for fired plans
DetGateRule objects with text_all conjunction support, file_impact glob/reason-regex matching must replace plain regex strings in _DET_OVERLAY_RULES and populate new _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES table
Skip recording via gate_log parameter in route_criteria must surface every not-fired gate in coverage.routing.det_gated JSON sidecar keyed by criterion id, visible in REVIEW_RESULT

Audit-validated trigger regexes for T13 (enforcement vocabulary), T14 (workflow/scheduler/release vocabulary with file globs), removal-rationale (removal keywords and file_impact reason regex), and asserted-capability (two-leg conjunction: module-ref and capability-verb) must fire on representative evasion sentences with zero false negatives
